_notes: 18840 'Deus, ne sileas a me, remitte mihi': breviary antiphon adapting Ps 38:13-14 Vulg (= 思高 Ps 39:13-14); 'ne sileas' = 莫要沉默/不听 (思高: 莫要作聋不听我的哭号), 'remitte mihi' = 宽赦我 (Vulg Ps 38:14). | 18853-18854: Advent liturgical antiphons drawn from Ex 16:6-7; rendered as established formulae, not from 思高 Ex directly since the Vulgate form differs. | 18857 'In conspectu Angelorum': 思高 Ps 138:1 reads '在众神前' (elohim); the Latin 'Angelorum' reflects a different interpretive tradition; retained 思高 '众神前' per rule. | 18862 'spes mea in Deo est': 思高 Ps 62:8 does not include 'spes' explicitly (uses 堡垒/护卫); rendered 希望 for spes to preserve the Latin sense while keeping 思高 first clause. | 18863 composite antiphon: 'Videte opera Domini' ≈ Ps 66:5 思高; 'auditam facite vocem laudis eius' ≈ Ps 66:8 思高 adapted.
